{{Top|leg}}
'''Sun Sweep''' was the name given to a hairstyle. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was known to have worn her hair in this style.<ref name="Kenner 12-inch">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|packtype=Large Size Action Figure|pack=Princess Leia Organa|altlink=http://theswca.com/images-toys/12inch/12in-leia.html}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Leia_hairstyles-Kenner.jpg|250px|thumb|Hairstyles from Kenner's Leia large-size action figure package]]
The term "Sun Sweep" comes from the packaging and instructions from [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] large-sized Leia action figure, which included a brush and comb and encouraged children to style her hair in various looks. They mention four other hairstyles: [[Star Puffs]] (her famous hairstyle from {{Film|IV}}), [[Star Burst]], [[Star Swirl]], and [[Lunar Loops]].<ref name="Kenner 12-inch" />
